prior_use_disclosure: All 96 images were revealed and used by the earlier L2/residual study. Q8-B outputs have not been measured on this set, but this is not a new blind test.
selector: geometric oracle using ground-truth bounding box

statistics.decision: PASS only if every primary metric's 95% CI lower bound is at or above its margin; DEGRADATION if any CI upper bound is below its margin; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE

diagnosis_trigger: Run paired failure attribution when the overall result is not PASS.
limitations: The selector reads ground-truth boxes and cannot be deployed.
The dataset was used in prior work and cannot support a new blind-test claim.
Process wall time includes model loading and is not a latency benchmark.
